mapper.select: SELECT value FROM common_config WHERE config_key = #{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO common_config (config_key, value) VALUES (#{key}, #{value}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value = VALUES(value)
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, network, provider, customer_id, address FROM pay_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND network = #{network}

SELECT user_id, network, provider, customer_id, address FROM pay_address WHERE network = #{network} AND (CASE WHEN #{network} = 'TRC20' THEN address = #{address} ELSE LOWER(address) = LOWER(#{address}) END) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO pay_address (user_id, network, provider, customer_id, address) VALUES (#{userId}, #{network}, #{provider}, #{customerId}, #{address})
mapper.sql: id, withdrawal_id, user_id, provider, idem_key, merchant_ref, network, address, amount, provider_ref, status, tx_hash, reason, first_submit_at, last_submit_at, submit_count, last_query_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pay_payout WHERE withdrawal_id = #{withdrawalId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM pay_payout WHERE withdrawal_id IN #{i}
SELECT FROM pay_payout WHERE provider = #{provider} AND provider_ref = #{ref}
SELECT FROM pay_payout WHERE provider = #{provider} AND merchant_ref = #{merchantRef}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO pay_payout (withdrawal_id, user_id, provider, idem_key, merchant_ref, network, address, amount, status, first_submit_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{withdrawalId}, #{userId}, #{provider}, #{idemKey}, #{merchantRef}, #{network}, #{address}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{firstSubmitAt}, #{firstSubmitAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE pay_payout SET last_submit_at = #{at}, submit_count = submit_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE pay_payout SET provider_ref = COALESCE(#{providerRef}, provider_ref), status = #{status}, tx_hash = COALESCE(#{txHash}, tx_hash), reason = COALESCE(#{reason}, reason), updated_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE pay_payout SET last_query_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO pay_callback (provider, event_id, event_type, ref) VALUES (#{provider}, #{eventId}, #{type}, #{ref})
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(received_at) FROM pay_callback WHERE provider = #{provider}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay_audit (admin_id, action, detail, reason) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{action}, #{detail}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT id, admin_id, action, detail, reason, created_at FROM pay_audit ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
